# Regease — Gaming Signup Form\n\nRecreation of ColorLib Regform 9 (https://colorlib.com/wp/template/colorlib-regform-9/).\n\n## Design tokens\n- Background: Full-page gaming image (picsum.photos)\n- Card: rgba(177, 135, 77, 0.75) — gold/brown translucent\n- Font: Poppins (Google Fonts)\n- Text: white throughout\n- Submit: white bg, gold text, rounded 25px, box shadow\n- Sign-in: white border 2px, rounded 25px\n- Inputs: transparent bg, bottom border only

## Delivery contract (repo rules — non-negotiable)

- **Footer credit.** The footer — or, when the design ships no footer, the page's
  last band — SHALL link [Component Dock](https://www.componentdock.com/). That is
  the only attribution line the recreation carries.
- **Source credit is reading, not copy.** Where the research above quotes the
  source's own credit string ("… made with ♥ by …"), it is what the source band
  renders: the recreation replaces it with the Component Dock credit.
- **Provenance ban.** No file under `apps/regease/` may name the source designer,
  carry a `colorlib.com` URL, or reuse the source template's name — code,
  comments, CSS, markup, metadata and filenames included (AGENTS.md rule 5).
- **Deploy identity.** `apps/regease/public/CNAME` = `regease.free.componentdock.com`
  and the package `homepage` = `https://regease.free.componentdock.com`.
